description: This Java interface defines a client for sending command and control messages to devices in the Eclipse Hono platform. It includes methods for sending commands expecting responses, as well as one-way commands without responses, with options for additional headers and content types.

classes.name: CommandClient
classes.description: An interface for a client that interacts with Hono's Command and Control API, supporting synchronous command sending with options for custom headers and payloads.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a device expecting a response, with optional data and error handling based on device reply.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to a device with specified contentType, headers, and data, expecting a response.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command to a device without expecting a response, with optional contentType and headers.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command with specified contentType, headers, and data, without expecting a response.
